description: A React component for the Explore page in Apache Superset, handling data fetching, state management, and rendering of the ExploreViewContainer with integration to Redux and various utility functions.

methods.name: isValidResult
methods.description: Checks if the API response contains valid form data and dataset.

methods.name: hasDatasetId
methods.description: Checks if the dataset ID exists in the API response.

methods.name: fetchExploreData
methods.description: Fetches explore data from API and handles fallback if dataset is missing.

methods.name: getDashboardPageContext
methods.description: Retrieves dashboard context data from local storage based on page ID.

methods.name: getDashboardContextFormData
methods.description: Constructs form data for the dashboard context, including filters and configurations.
